git.parent_incumbent_source: git show 0852ac4d:src/spider/kernel.py, reimplemented as the A3 declared-vocabulary arm because freeze.json pins no code hash

code_paths.src/spider/kernel.py: incumbent declared-vocabulary kernel plus the VariabilityBinders mixin
code_paths.src/spider/variability.py: variability induction, LOO calibration, variability binder and the three null binders
code_paths.EXP-PRODUCT-36314204238/substrate.py: deterministic authenticated stdlib HTTP substrate with injectable latency
code_paths.EXP-PRODUCT-36314204238/run_experiment.p: EXECUTE stage: emits raw evidence only, no interpretation
code_paths.EXP-PRODUCT-36314204238/build_result.py: DERIVED stage: metrics, frozen falsifier panel, frozen decision rule, packet outputs

training_observations.requests: 3 per observation (list, then two verb actions)

test_tasks.out_of_support: widgets 151-200, syntactically well formed and present in the substrate

fixtures.substrate: 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port, bearer token auth, 0.2 ms base latency x multiplier, deterministic state

commands: PYTHONPATH=../../.. python3 run_experiment.py   # EXECUTE, writes raw_evidence/ only
python3 build_result.py                          # DERIVED, writes derived.json, mechanisms.json, result.json, report.md, provenance.json
reproduction_notes: run_experiment.py writes only raw_evidence/*.jsonl and *.json; it computes no metrics and applies no decision rule.
build_result.py reads only raw_evidence/ and is deterministic: no randomness outside the seeded bootstrap (B=5000, seed 42).
The bootstrap resamples identifiers within (family, collection) strata, per prereg section 8.1.
A4 is scored at the better of two measured tie orders; both raw series are preserved so an auditor can score it either way.
not_reproduced_here: Multi-template routes, multi-site transfer, real browser or JS substrates, any LLM-in-the-loop economics: all outside this frozen design and outside this substrate's validity history.
